items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: So Ernest Holland told Danny, I said, well man, why don't you give Curtis the kitty?

ctx.x: You know where Safari was? Yeah, Safari was.

He used to come around trying to get us all the time, but we didn't want to go, because you know. But after the Cat fired us, we started working out there. Making more money, man, and everything. You know. That one guy used to come around, man. That guy, man, used to, like when we'd knock off at the Safari, he'd have his girlfriend there and have us playing overtime because he'd keep filling the kitty with money. You know? Man, and see what happened, when I was around for Danny, I wasn't charging him nothing. So…
